title: jsbubble: an interactive evolver for planar bubble clusters
description:
A browser application that lets you draw planar bubble clusters and watch them evolve towards a (locally) minimal cluster, i.e. a configuration of least perimeter with prescribed areas.

You can change the target area of each bubble, split, flip, remove or collapse edges, split vertices with at least four edges, pin vertices, show the instantaneous forces and enable automatic topological changes.

To run it offline, unzip the archive and open index.html in a web browser: all dependencies are bundled.

Online version: https://paolini.github.io/jsbubble/
